column5: Document the Perl version() and parse_special() functions and the $abiversion special variable. This was incorrectly listed in the 1.4.1 NEWS but was not actually present until now
Autoload the IRC protocol module and load its config when the chat protocol is created
Remove the autotools build system in favour of meson
Remove the enable-true-color compile-time switch and always enable 24-bit true color
Remove deprecated compile-time build options such as PERL_STATIC_LIBS, HAVE_SOCKS and USE_GREGEX
Add some missing files to make-dist
Simplify the termux GitHub Actions workflow
Abort the meson build (and bump the required meson version) when run in an autotools-configured tree
Fix bound IRC queries not being restored on reconnect
Add a new PUBNOTICES message level to separate public channel notices from private notices
Add an OBS workflow trigger
Fix /names sending a raw server event by binding it first
Revert the Neirssi branding change back to Irssi in the README and startup banner
Add a GitHub Actions workflow to trigger the website pages build
Speed up the Termux package CI by no longer building the perl package separately
Fix a crash when loading a server set up without a chatnet
Exit gracefully on SIGTERM by emitting "gui exit" and quitting
Add list-of-lists support and clearer error messages to the config parser, and fix a time zone assertion by parsing ISO 8601 times as UTC
Build the Termux package from a git source URL
Update GitHub Actions workflows for deprecated set-output and artifact actions
Prefer IPv6 by default when resolving
Fix a crash on connect during startup when no chat protocol is available
Update the GitHub Actions workflows to a newer Ubuntu runner image
Properly format listmodes and their timestamps, add human-readable relative times, and support ircd-hybrid quiet lists
Add a command_history_editable setting to enable bash-like editing of command history entries
Fix a crash when adding a server
Add SET window_default_ to the "See also" section of the window help
Improve the bind help text to better explain upper- and lowercase key usage
Document pkg-config as a build dependency required by meson to find glib
Restore the locale if Perl breaks it
Fix typos in the scrollback help text
Add a missing include to fix the fuzz build under clang-18
Fix missing shell quotes in the irssi-version.sh helper script
Add support for the SCRAM-SHA-1, SCRAM-SHA-256 and SCRAM-SHA-512 SASL mechanisms
Update the minimum required Perl version in the README
Update GitHub Actions to newer Node.js versions
Fix a glib deprecation in module loading, which may allow loading Apple dylibs with new enough glib
Replace a deprecated OpenSSL 3 function
Ensure all text files end with a newline
Fix irssi switching to a Unix socket when the network name contains a slash
Fix the /BAN command, which was broken by an earlier change
Document the capsicum settings section in the capsicum docs
Bump actions/upload-artifact from the deprecated v1 to v4 in CI
Fix the GitHub workflows by pinning setuptools and meson and adding the glib dependency
Fix uninitialised memory in the CTCP ping reply
Fix SASL negotiation failing when multiple CAP ACK lines are received
Add ipaddr and chosen_family fields to the Perl connection record
Fix building on Solaris by namespacing TERM_REC functions that conflict with curses.h, and add a Solaris CI build
Include <sys/select.h> to get select(3), fixing the build on strict POSIX libcs
Replace obsolescent inet_addr/inet_aton with inet_pton
Use EAI_NONAME instead of HOST_NOT_FOUND for getaddrinfo(3) errors
Remove const qualifiers in fe-text terminfo for better Darwin support
Update GitHub Actions to Ubuntu 22.04
Make bitfields unsigned to silence compiler warnings
Adapt the PEP 440 dev version scheme in make-dist.sh
Add a Void Linux Docker build to GitHub Actions
Fix the Void Linux GitHub Actions workflow
Fix a build issue by adding a missing wchar.h include in the Perl core
Fix two memory leaks when creating a main window with not enough space
Fix a _GNU_SOURCE redefined warning caused by Perl ccflags
Fix the Solaris GitHub Actions test by detecting the third argument type of puts
Document the existing -priority option in the HILIGHT syntax help
Fix the xbps Void Linux GitHub Actions workflow
Use g_string_free_and_steal to avoid an unused-result warning on GLib 2.76
Fix a typo in the LUSERS help text
Increase the default scrollback_lines from 500 to 5000
Fix nickname truncation in netsplit messages to avoid a trailing comma-space
Fix hide_text_style and hide_colors to mitigate color bleed on the reset control code
Update bundled scripts autoop, mail, and scriptassist
Update package lists in the abicheck GitHub Actions workflow
Update syncdocs.sh to sync the New-users and qna docs, dropping faq and startup-HOWTO
Make compilation work on Cygwin by using shared_library instead of shared_module
Use the GIO resolver for name resolution and rename the resolve_prefer_ipv6 setting to irssiproxy_prefer_ipv6
Document additional compile dependencies (utf8proc, libgcrypt, complete Perl) in INSTALL
Move the Perl DCC glue into a separate Irssi::Irc::Dcc module so Irssi::Irc can be used with dcc unloaded
Fix the clang-format-xs tooling boot code and comment spacing
Add compatibility code for older GResolver versions
Fix several issues with the GIO resolver
Add a muon meson-format GitHub Actions workflow and reformat the meson build files
